overview.title: Overview
overview.intro: Today's generation mix, prices and renewable share.
overview.noData: No data has been loaded yet.
overview.apiError: The API is not reachable right now.

price.title: Day-ahead price today
price.note: Wholesale price, without taxes, levies and grid fees. Times are in German time ({{zone}}).
price.emptyNewest: Today's prices aren't available. The newest prices we have run up to {{time}}.
price.chartLabel: Line chart of today's day-ahead price in {{unit}}. Lowest {{low}}, highest {{high}}.
price.tableCaption: Day-ahead price today by time, in German time ({{zone}})

generation.error: The generation figures couldn't be loaded.
generation.empty: Today's generation figures aren't available yet.
generation.emptyNewest: Today's generation figures aren't available. The newest we have run up to {{time}}.
generation.note: Energy per hour in MWh, for complete hours only. Times are in German time ({{zone}}).
generation.tableCaption: Electricity generation today by source, in MWh per hour, in German time ({{zone}})

renewable.title: Renewable share today
renewable.note: Solar, wind, biomass, hydropower and other renewables as a share of all electricity generated in Germany so far today. Pumped storage doesn't count as renewable.
renewable.emptyNewest: Not available for today. The newest figures run up to {{time}}.

overview.outdated: The data is out of date: the last successful update was {{ago}}. The charts show the latest data we have.

tomorrow.title: Tomorrow
tomorrow.intro: Tomorrow's day-ahead prices and the cheapest hours to use electricity.
tomorrow.heading: Day-ahead price on {{day}}
tomorrow.notPublished: The prices for {{day}} aren't published yet. They usually appear around 13:00 German time.
tomorrow.notPublishedNewest: The prices for {{day}} aren't published yet. They usually appear around 13:00 German time. The newest prices we have run up to {{time}}.
tomorrow.incomplete: Some quarter-hours of {{day}} are missing at the source. Windows that would include them are left out.
tomorrow.noWindow: There is no complete window to show: quarter-hours are missing.
tomorrow.chartLabel: Line chart of tomorrow's day-ahead price in {{unit}}. The cheapest and the most expensive {{hours}}-hour window are marked: cheapest {{cheapest}}, most expensive {{expensive}}.
tomorrow.tableCaption: Day-ahead price on {{day}} by time, in German time ({{zone}})

explorer.title: Explorer
explorer.intro: Any series over any time range, shareable by link.

explain.title: Explain a day
explain.intro: Ask about a day on the electricity market. Answers come from the same data as the charts.

assistant.label: Assistant
assistant.emptyIntro: Ask about generation, prices or the renewable share. Try one of these:

starters.priceRange: What was the day-ahead price range yesterday?
starters.windSolar: How much electricity did wind and solar produce yesterday?
starters.updated: When was the data last updated?

assistant.hint: Enter sends, Shift+Enter starts a new line.
assistant.truncated: The answer reached its length limit and may be cut off.
assistant.privacy: Your questions are sent to Google's Gemini service (free tier), which may use them to improve its products. Please don't enter personal data. The assistant can be wrong: check important figures in the charts.

errors.rate_limited: The assistant has used up its free quota for now. Please try again in a few minutes.
errors.unavailable: The model service isn't available right now. Please try again in a moment.
errors.blocked: The model declined to answer this question. Try asking it differently.
errors.failed: Something went wrong while answering. Please try again.
errors.off: The assistant is switched off at the moment.
errors.busy: Too many questions right now. Please wait a minute and try again.
errors.invalid: That question couldn't be sent. Try a shorter one.
errors.network: The connection was interrupted. Please try again.

error.title: Something went wrong

error.tooManyRequests_other: Too many requests. Please try again in {{count}} seconds.
error.tooManyRequestsNoWait: Too many requests. Please wait a moment and try again.
